context.user-input: a stretch of work closed and handed to whoever opens the next one

instruction.user-input: read this as the opening context of the next order, never as an order itself

note.user-input: where the work is, not where it should be

core.needs: the version or checkpoint the work sits at, and the branch or location it sits on

ready.needs: the standing gate: the one command that decides whether this state is true, and what it exits with

where.user-input: the last completed D1, from which the next agent resumes

note.user-input: the one shape behind the blockers, when there is one

problem.needs: the shape every blocker in this stretch shared

example.needs: one concrete occurrence, named — repeat the line once per case

learn.needs: what the shape teaches, stated so it survives outside this stretch

note.user-input: what finished here — each item observable by someone who did not do the work

finally.needs: a D1 or D2 that closed, stated as the behaviour that changed and not as the file that moved

note.user-input: numbers, not estimates — a figure with no method is an estimate wearing a number

equal.needs: the figure, and how it was obtained

note.user-input: what needs the Regente, and whether each blocks the others

question.needs: a decision only the Regente may take, and what it blocks — repeat once per question

assumption.needs: what is taken as given here and was never verified

note.user-input: the order the work has if nothing changes

instruction.needs: the next D2 or D1 in dependency order — the name and why it comes now, no further detail

limitation.needs: what continues without waiting on any of the open questions

note.user-input: how this was worked — the part that transfers

constraint.needs: a rule that held, stated so it binds the next agent and not only this one
